<thought>To locate a suitable retrosynthetic template, I will query the template catalog using only the target flavanone SMILES and a modest limit, without any functional‑group or bond filters. This should return a list of candidate templates, from which I can identify the one that corresponds to the intramolecular Michael cyclization of a chalcone to a flavanone.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
